about: 40 questions over the docs/*.md snapshot in corpus.json. Each answerable question names the source file and a phrase that must appear in the retrieved chunk; the expected chunk ids are resolved from the phrase through the shipped chunker. Written 2026-09-25 from the text alone and frozen before any ranker was run.

questions.query: What is the default for cron.quota_hold_minutes?
What does goals.max_continuations bound, and what is its default?
How long may a voice note be before gateway.voice_notes.max_seconds refuses it?
What does media.image_auto_approve_under_cents do when it is left at 0?
questions.phrase: is the one lift. It is `0` by default

questions.query: What share of fixtures does improve.holdout_ratio hold back?
When does context.compact_after_chars trigger a compaction?
How many turns does repl.history_turns carry to the next run by default?
What does the agent card advertise when TRENT_A2A_TOKEN is not set?
questions.phrase: the card carries no `security` at all

questions.query: If TRENT_BROWSER_PATH is unset, which executables are looked for on PATH?
Why is the app's encryptJson not reused when SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY is missing?
questions.phrase: its key derives from a public constant

questions.query: Where were HARDLINE_PATTERNS ported from?
What is the default of heartbeat.interval_minutes?
How long may the checklist of pending chores grow for a job, and how many past jobs are remembered?
On Apple computers, what is the minimum pause before the supervised helper comes back after crashing?
questions.phrase: at most once every 30 seconds by `ThrottleInterval`

questions.query: By how much does each red flag lower the safety rating of an add-on?
How long before a freshly issued handset-matching passcode lapses?
questions.phrase: random codes with a one-hour expiry

questions.query: Which role is given the tightest money allowance for a job?
Without a container, how long may an unconfined shell instruction last before being killed?
Can edits produced via console programs within the jail be reversed afterwards?
questions.phrase: writes made by the `terminal` and `code` toolsets inside the sandbox

questions.query: What keystroke brings the native program's frame forward or tucks it away?
At what size is the background helper's diary swapped for a fresh one?
questions.phrase: it rotates at 1 MiB, one old file kept

questions.query: How big may a single code unit grow before somebody ought to consider carving it apart?
questions.phrase: approaching 400 lines triggers a decomposition review

questions.query: What is the maximum length of an update on the decentralised microblogging network?
How patient is each individual diagnostic before abandoning?
My CI pipeline cannot find the JavaScript runtime that works fine in my own shell. What is going on?
I accidentally launched the chat bridge in two terminals for one account. Will people get duplicate replies?
questions.phrase: a second start on the same profile exits 3

questions.query: My Linux box reboots unattended and nobody signs in. How will the assistant still come up?
Suppose I hand-tweak what the assistant produced, then ask to revert its latest turn. Is my tweak lost?
questions.phrase: Refuses, as a whole, if any path fails a check

questions.query: I tried registering an external connector with my access password pasted in literally and it was rejected. Why?
If I approve a text to a customer whose phone number is written wrong, does it still go out?
questions.phrase: Even if approved it sends nothing

questions.query: Can my agents rewrite an instruction pack that shipped with the product itself?
The model claimed the work was done even though the build was red. How does Trent avoid trusting that?
questions.phrase: A red gate ends the run `gated`

questions.query: Could the bot privately chat with a follower on Zuckerberg's platforms?
When verifying my Gemini credential, could it leak into an intermediary's access records?
Files the isolated environment tried saving got refused on my Linux CI, yet on Apple hardware everything was fine. Why?
How do I configure SAML single sign-on for my team's workspace?
How much is the Trent Pro subscription per month?
How do I deploy the fleet on a Kubernetes cluster with Helm?
How do I sync customer records with Salesforce?
Does Trent support live voice calls over WebRTC?
